verdict.rationale: Observability dashboards are a fair question for a serverless platform, so the axis applies. However, the pack documents no custom dashboard builder that combines metrics from arbitrary services. The evidence covers only built-in Workers logs/observability and fixed AI Gateway metrics (requests, tokens, cost), which are adjacent features. Building your own dashboard app on Workers would be a developer building block, not the capability itself.

support.subject: As a devops-lead, I can build custom dashboards combining metrics from any service
